history_summary: Ground the generic PCC 6803 reference descriptor while preserving engineered PPT1 and PPHET guild limits.
history_details: The exact NCBITaxon:1148 route supplies Synechocystis sp000284455 with total_genomes 22 and majority_fraction 1.0, without an explicit support numerator. This reference population does not identify a sequenced engineered PPT1 genome, verify its mutations or establish stock equivalence. Preserve the existing note limiting engineered-strain classification, the separate Bacteria descriptor and all source/stock/biology/history content. One selected reference block, one status and two native inline events change. The paper constructs PPHET from engineered PPT1 plus the selectively retained WCRM heterotroph fraction; the GFP culture is a parallel control. Preserve the corrected broad ~30% heterotroph and ~70% cyanobacterial composition and the distinction from Proteobacteria alone. Issue1674's guild/assay limits remain unresolved; closed historical repairs1669/2514 are not reopened or treated as scientific clearance. Generic reference mapping does not resolve the causal/mechanistic or member-identity limits. Crosswalk release is unestablished and NCBI provenance is file-stat based. This is partial technical correspondence work, not full scientific review, measured reference validation, generated products or corpus QC.
